explication: xmonad is an extensible X11 tiling window manager. Keyboard or optional mouse input reaches its event loop, which dispatches commands, applies window rules, maintains workspace state, computes configurable layouts, and places windows through X11. Configuration files define bindings and layouts; optional xmonad-contrib extensions broaden those choices. The graph reflects the README and repository structure; no source excerpts were available, so internal call edges are limited to relationships implied by the documented runtime and module responsibilities.
